title: South African Road Signs and Road Markings
note: Study the sign or road marking, understand its meaning, and learn the safe action required. Illustrations should be checked against the applicable South African Road Traffic Signs Manual before use in formal assessments.

signs.name: Stop control
signs.meaning: Stop, but if you want to turn left, you can use it as a yield sign.
signs.studyPoint: Stop, but if you want to turn left, you can use it as a yield sign.

signs.name: Stop control
signs.meaning: Stop and drive on when it is safe to do so in the sequence that the vehicles stopped at the stop lines
signs.studyPoint: Stop and drive on when it is safe to do so in the sequence that the vehicles stopped at the stop lines

signs.name: Pedestrian-only / pedestrian priority sign
signs.meaning: You must give right of way to pedestrians who would like to enter or cross the road.
signs.studyPoint: You must give right of way to pedestrians who would like to enter or cross the road.

signs.name: No-entry sign
signs.meaning: You are not allowed to enter there
signs.studyPoint: You are not allowed to enter there

signs.name: Minimum / speed control sign
signs.meaning: Slowest speed that you may drive
signs.studyPoint: Slowest speed that you may drive

signs.name: Mass-restriction lane
signs.meaning: Vehicles exceeding the mass indicated must use this lane only.
signs.studyPoint: Vehicles exceeding the mass indicated must use this lane only.

signs.name: Lane-direction indication
signs.meaning: Will get a freeway ahead
signs.studyPoint: Will get a freeway ahead

signs.name: Turn right only
signs.meaning: Turn right only.
signs.studyPoint: Turn right only.

signs.name: No hooting / hooter prohibition
signs.meaning: Prohibits you from using your hooter
signs.studyPoint: Prohibits you from using your hooter

signs.name: Unauthorised vehicle prohibited
signs.meaning: Unauthorised vehicles are prohibited.
signs.studyPoint: Unauthorised vehicles are prohibited.

signs.name: No left turn
signs.meaning: Turning left is prohibited at the intersection where the sign is displayed.
signs.studyPoint: Do not turn left where this sign applies.

signs.name: Priority / passing restriction
signs.meaning: No motor vehicles may pass each other
signs.studyPoint: No motor vehicles may pass each other

signs.name: 100 km/h maximum speed at night
signs.meaning: The maximum speed is 100 km/h during night-time conditions, as indicated by the supplementary plate.
signs.studyPoint: A red-bordered 100 sign sets a maximum speed; the moon-and-stars plate limits the restriction to night-time.

signs.name: Crossroad ahead
signs.meaning: A crossroad is ahead. Be alert for traffic entering from either side.
signs.studyPoint: The sign warns of a crossroad; it does not by itself say that cross traffic must stop or yield.

signs.name: Two-way traffic ahead
signs.meaning: Traffic will travel in both directions ahead. Keep left and watch for oncoming traffic.
signs.studyPoint: Prepare for oncoming traffic; do not assume the road remains one-way.

signs.name: Concealed entrances on both sides
signs.meaning: A concealed entrance to the left is followed by one to the right.
signs.studyPoint: A concealed entrance to the left is followed by one to the right.

signs.name: Pedestrian crossing
signs.meaning: Pedestrian crossing.
signs.studyPoint: Pedestrian crossing.

signs.name: Cyclist warning
signs.meaning: It is a special lane for cyclists
signs.studyPoint: It is a special lane for cyclists

signs.name: Motor gate (to the left)
signs.meaning: Motor gate to the left.
signs.studyPoint: Motor gate to the left.

signs.name: One-vehicle-width structure ahead
signs.meaning: A narrow structure ahead may only allow one vehicle to pass through at a time.
signs.studyPoint: Slow down and be prepared to give way to oncoming traffic if the structure cannot accommodate two vehicles.

signs.name: Construction vehicle warning
signs.meaning: Construction vehicles may enter or cross the road ahead.
signs.studyPoint: Construction vehicles may enter or cross the road ahead.

signs.name: Jetty edge / river bank
signs.meaning: There is a jetty edge or river bank ahead.
signs.studyPoint: There is a jetty edge or river bank ahead.

signs.name: Low-water bridge ahead
signs.meaning: A low-water bridge or crossing is ahead. Water may flow over the crossing.
signs.studyPoint: Approach carefully. Never enter a flooded crossing if the depth or current makes it unsafe.

signs.name: Agricultural vehicles warning
signs.meaning: Be on the lookout for agricultural vehicles that may be on the road
signs.studyPoint: Be on the lookout for agricultural vehicles that may be on the road

signs.name: Obstruction / keep-pass direction
signs.meaning: Temporary obstruction left of the road / Pass on the right of this sign
signs.studyPoint: Temporary obstruction left of the road / Pass on the right of this sign

signs.name: Stop control
signs.meaning: Be ready to stop and turn left or right
signs.studyPoint: Be ready to stop and turn left or right

signs.name: Winding road ahead — 80 km/h advisory speed for 12 km
signs.meaning: A winding section lies ahead for 12 km. The 80 km/h plate gives an advisory speed, not by itself a regulatory speed limit.
signs.studyPoint: Reduce speed to suit the curves and conditions. The advisory speed is guidance; obey any separate posted speed limit.

signs.name: No throughway
signs.meaning: Through traffic is not permitted beyond this point. Follow any posted diversion or turn-around instructions.
signs.studyPoint: Do not continue straight through. Follow the road signs and any diversion instructions to choose a permitted route.

signs.name: Overhead lane-direction control signal — red cross
signs.meaning: Do not drive in the lane beneath the red cross. The lane may be open to traffic travelling in the opposite direction.
signs.studyPoint: Follow the signal above your lane. A green downward arrow permits use of that lane; a red cross prohibits use.

signs.name: Painted island / chevron marking
signs.meaning: Painted island where you are not allowed to drive on or stop
signs.studyPoint: Painted island where you are not allowed to drive on or stop

signs.name: Yield line / yield marking
signs.meaning: Yield for vehicles that have crossed the yield line before you.
signs.studyPoint: Yield for vehicles that have crossed the yield line before you.

signs.name: Railway crossing warning / signal
signs.meaning: There is a level crossing with one railway line ahead
signs.studyPoint: There is a level crossing with one railway line ahead

signs.name: Lane direction / lane transition marking
signs.meaning: The lane splits into more lanes in the direction of the arrow
signs.studyPoint: The lane splits into more lanes in the direction of the arrow

signs.name: Mini-buses
signs.meaning: Mini-buses.

signs.name: Road to the left is not a through road
signs.meaning: Do not use this road if you need a through road to the left.
signs.studyPoint: Do not use this road if you need a through road to the left.

signs.name: Lane line marking (GM1)
signs.meaning: Shows the lanes for road users
signs.studyPoint: Shows the lanes for road users

signs.name: Lane direction / lane transition marking
signs.meaning: Can turn right or move straight on if it is safe
signs.studyPoint: Can turn right or move straight on if it is safe

signs.name: No-stopping / parking restriction marking
signs.meaning: May not park there at all because it’s a no stopping road marking.
signs.studyPoint: May not park there at all because it’s a no stopping road marking.

signs.name: Stop control
signs.meaning: If you are driving in car A, must stop before this line
signs.studyPoint: If you are driving in car A, must stop before this line

signs.name: Stop-line / pedestrian-line marking
signs.meaning: Show you that you may not stop further than the front one of the two
signs.studyPoint: Show you that you may not stop further than the front one of the two

signs.name: Direction at junction
signs.meaning: At the junction ahead, you must turn in the direction of the arrow.
signs.studyPoint: At the junction ahead, you must turn in the direction of the arrow.

signs.name: Time-restricted parking prohibition
signs.meaning: Parking there at certain hours
signs.studyPoint: Parking there at certain hours

signs.name: Secondary crossroad
signs.meaning: Secondary crossroad.
signs.studyPoint: Secondary crossroad.

signs.name: Curve / bend warning

signs.studyPoint: Sharp curve to the left ahead

signs.name: Traffic signal / robot warning
signs.meaning: There is a robot ahead
signs.studyPoint: There is a robot ahead

signs.name: Gravel road begins
signs.meaning: The surface of the road ahead changes to gravel.
signs.studyPoint: The surface of the road ahead changes to gravel.

signs.name: Road narrows from both sides
signs.meaning: The road becomes narrower on both the left and right sides ahead.
signs.studyPoint: Reduce speed and be prepared for a narrower roadway. Keep a safe position and watch for oncoming traffic.

signs.name: Speed hump warning
signs.meaning: There are speed humps in the road
signs.studyPoint: There are speed humps in the road

signs.name: Slippery road
signs.meaning: The road surface is very smooth, especially when wet.
signs.studyPoint: The road surface is very smooth, especially when wet.

signs.studyPoint: There is danger in the road ahead

signs.name: Obstruction / hazard on the right — keep left
signs.meaning: There is an obstruction or hazard on the right; keep left.
signs.studyPoint: There is an obstruction or hazard on the right; keep left.

signs.name: Pothole warning
signs.meaning: Potholes are to be found on the road ahead
signs.studyPoint: Potholes are to be found on the road ahead

signs.name: Stop / yield road marking
signs.meaning: Stop
signs.studyPoint: Stop

signs.name: Barrier / no-crossing marking
signs.meaning: Traffic may not overtake or cross it on either side
signs.studyPoint: Traffic may not overtake or cross it on either side

signs.name: Reserved parking / loading marking
signs.meaning: Business vehicles
signs.studyPoint: Business vehicles

signs.name: Reserved parking / loading marking
signs.meaning: Goods vehicles that loads or unloads
signs.studyPoint: Goods vehicles that loads or unloads

signs.name: Broken yellow no-parking line
signs.meaning: Parking is prohibited alongside this broken yellow line during the times indicated on the relevant road sign. This is not the same as a red no-stopping line.
signs.studyPoint: A broken yellow line indicates a no-parking restriction during the times shown on the applicable sign. Check the sign for the restricted hours.

signs.meaning: Skew T-junction.
signs.studyPoint: Skew T-junction.

signs.studyPoint: You must pass to the right of this sign.

signs.studyPoint: Shows that you may have to stop and yield for pedestrians.

signs.name: Junction warning

signs.studyPoint: You are entering a freeway

signs.name: No U-turn sign
signs.meaning: A U-turn prohibited
signs.studyPoint: A U-turn prohibited

signs.name: Traffic circle
signs.meaning: Traffic circle.
signs.studyPoint: Traffic circle.

signs.name: Minimum / speed control sign
signs.meaning: Do not travel at a speed slower than the minimum speed indicated.
signs.studyPoint: Do not travel at a speed slower than the minimum speed indicated.

signs.name: Four-way stop
signs.meaning: Stop and proceed only when it is safe to do so.
signs.studyPoint: Stop and proceed only when it is safe to do so.

signs.name: No through road to the right
signs.meaning: There is no through road to the right.

signs.name: Right-of-way / priority sign

signs.name: Emergency telephone sign
signs.meaning: There is an emergency phone 500m ahead in the road.
signs.studyPoint: There is an emergency phone 500m ahead in the road.

signs.name: Junction warning

signs.studyPoint: A side road junction from the right ahead.

signs.name: Temporary height limit
signs.meaning: Temporary height limit.
signs.studyPoint: Temporary height limit.

signs.name: Barrier / no-crossing marking

signs.name: Temporary sign background
signs.meaning: Temporary road signs generally use a yellow background to distinguish them from permanent signs.
signs.studyPoint: Yellow is the usual background colour for temporary road signs.

signs.studyPoint: The road is temporarily closed at this point. Slow down and use any detour indicated.

signs.name: Pedal cycles only
signs.meaning: Only cyclists may use that part of the road.
signs.studyPoint: Only cyclists may use that part of the road.

signs.name: Speed humps
signs.meaning: You may have to slow down.
signs.studyPoint: You may have to slow down.

signs.name: Exit countdown signs
signs.meaning: 200 m to the exit.
signs.studyPoint: 200 m to the exit.

signs.name: Temporary lane-use sign — minimum speed of 80 km/h in the right-hand lane
signs.meaning: This temporary lane-use control sign shows three lanes carrying traffic in the same direction. The 80 km/h minimum-speed requirement applies to the right-hand lane only.
signs.studyPoint: Keep to a lane appropriate for your vehicle and traffic conditions. The 80 km/h figure is a minimum speed for the indicated lane, not a maximum speed applying to all three lanes.

signs.name: Temporary minimum speed on the third lane
signs.meaning: Only vehicles that can exceed the speed indicated can travel on that lane.
signs.studyPoint: Only vehicles that can exceed the speed indicated can travel on that lane.

signs.name: Traffic signal turning indication
signs.meaning: You may travel in the direction of the arrow only if it is safe to do so.
signs.studyPoint: You may travel in the direction of the arrow only if it is safe to do so.

signs.name: No crossing at all
signs.meaning: No crossing is permitted.
signs.studyPoint: No crossing is permitted.

signs.name: Exit countdown marker
signs.meaning: Exit countdown marker.
signs.studyPoint: Exit countdown marker.

signs.name: Alternative route sign
signs.meaning: There is an alternative route at the next road to the right.

signs.name: Road to the right is not a through road
signs.meaning: Do not use this road if you need a through road to your right.
signs.studyPoint: Do not use this road if you need a through road to your right.

signs.name: One-way roadway
signs.meaning: Travel only in the direction of the arrow.

signs.name: Toll route / alternative route sign
signs.meaning: There is a toll road and an alternative to the toll road.
signs.studyPoint: There is a toll road and an alternative to the toll road.

signs.name: Disabled parking marking
signs.meaning: The area is set aside for disabled persons.
signs.studyPoint: The area is set aside for disabled persons.

signs.studyPoint: There is a dead end on the road ahead.

signs.name: Barrier / no-crossing marking
signs.meaning: No overtaking is allowed.

signs.name: Lane directions

signs.studyPoint: The left lane is reducing.

signs.name: Bus lane only
signs.meaning: It is for the exclusive use of buses only.
signs.studyPoint: It is for the exclusive use of buses only.

signs.name: Bus-only lane marking
signs.meaning: The lane is reserved for buses, subject to the applicable road signs and markings.
signs.studyPoint: Do not use a bus-only lane unless you are permitted to do so.

signs.name: Additional traffic lane
signs.meaning: Lane increase ahead.
signs.studyPoint: Lane increase ahead.

signs.name: Dividing line
signs.meaning: A dividing line separates traffic lanes or opposing traffic streams, according to the road layout and line type.
signs.studyPoint: Observe the line type: a broken line and a solid line have different crossing rules.

signs.name: Motorcycle engine capacity limit
signs.meaning: Motorcycles with an engine capacity of more than 125 cc are prohibited.
signs.studyPoint: Motorcycles with an engine capacity of more than 125 cc are prohibited.
